items.title: Howard Johnson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2019
items.q: You played with Archie Shepp and some people say that much of that music sounds angry. Yeah, they always said that.

ctx.x: Yeah, what do you think about that?

Yeah. About Archie’s especially because he was very aggressive. Well they called Coltrane angry. So much beauty in Coltrane, you know, whether it’s fast or slow. It’s almost delicate to me, you know, the loudest Coltrane stuff you can find seems delicate.

I’m wondering if you — go ahead — if you ever turned, at that time, you’re in New York trying to make a living, I imagine that the typical jazz gig, which you were happy to get, probably didn’t pay that much? So did you ever turn down a gig at that time?
